geometric_definition.radius_limit: Single engineering threshold; original paper runtime units are not fully traceable
geometric_definition.normalization: NONE; never normalize the generated bbox
geometric_definition.known_vertex_identity: FP32 coordinate bytes, including signed zero
geometric_definition.anchor_rule: one distinct numeric C coordinate within radius; conflicting coordinates leave free corner fixed
geometric_definition.free_rule: lexicographic original-point representatives; nearest existing representative within radius; no transitive unions or means
geometric_definition.degenerate_rule: free only: exact repeated coordinate or exactly zero FP64 cross product
geometric_definition.duplicate_rule: free only: same three numeric coordinates ignoring winding; C wins, then first retained free source face

minimum_altitude_definition: 2 * triangle area / longest edge; not semantic timber width
width_threshold: Descriptive comparison only to existing GEO radius; no threshold sweep or mesh modification
area_definition: Triangle area sum, not union coverage; deleted area does not certify missing visible surface
lineage: Generated RAW slot, not source-parent GT face

engineering_recovery.reason: Final JSON serialization of numpy.int64; all geometry identity checks and CSV/example writes had completed
engineering_recovery.recovery: Read saved CSV only and reverify input hashes; no repeated geometry processing or scoring
